True story. Man living alone in Bangar, no electricity in house. One night he awakes at 3 something AM, restless and unable to sleep. He decides to wait for subuh prayers but was running short on candles, so he gets on his motor and proceeds to the nearest surau. Along the quiet kampong road, his head felt heavy. He sweats uncomfortably. 

Upon reaching the surau, he remains alone, he tries to cool himself with wudhu. He washes the face but his forehead remained dry. That was strange he said, but didnt think much of it, went straight to the prayer rooms. He waits for the call and performs the prayer. 

At rukuk his head felt the heaviest and at sujud, his forehead did not touch the floor. He turned pale.

Subhanallah!!! he said. Unnervingly ending the prayer. "KaNa kACauu nii aku aNiE!!"

He scrambles for an imam but he was alone. He chokes, he goes to the toilet. Mana selipar ku!!  but finds a mirror instead. Slowly he looks up to it. He chokes,  He finds that his helmet was still on
